title: The Dow Market Happenings For Tuesday, January 30, 2018
text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Tuesday, January 30, 2018 Posted by admin on January 30th,   Cisco (CSCO), Goldman Sachs (GS), Home Depot, Intel (INTC), JPMorgan (JPM), McDonald’s (MCD), Pfizer (PFE), UnitedHealth   There  192 points. 
Monday the Dow was down -1.77.23 (-0.67%) at 26,439.48. 
Year-to-date the Dow is up +6.96%. 
There were 5 Dow stocks up Monday. 
The Dow stock winners Monday were led by Goldman Sachs (GS) +1.62% and Wal-Mart (WMT) +1.07%. 
The Dow stock losers Monday were led by Caterpillar (CAT) -2.68% and Apple (AAPL) -2.07%. 
Apple (AAPL -2.07%) is down 1% in premarket trading on carry-over weakness from Monday when it fell 2.6% when Nikkei reported Apple will cut its Q1 iPhone X production in half due to slower than expected holiday sales. 
The Fed meets today and tomorrow. 
European stocks are lower   seven-tenths of a cent at $2.586   reported earnings on 1/30/2018 before the market open of $0.62, beating estimates of $0.583 per share. 
McDonald’s (MCD) reported earnings on 1/30/2018 before the market open of $0.87, missing estimates calling for $1.616 per share. 
  
Wal-Mart (WMT) 
Wal-Mart (WMT) is up +10.94% year-to-date.
